display_long_description:
Inwigo is a co-op VR horror extraction game where you play as a child, explore Morrowen's creepy carnival, and explore Thornwake Manor, where you're tasked with navigating endless hallways and rooms, outsmarting adaptive monsters, uncovering treasures, and surviving a shared ghost story VR!!                     

[media]

Hunt Thornwake Manor in cooperative VR with your friends. Everything feels bigger, closer, and more unsettling when you’re small, and you’re never truly alone. Stick together or set off in different directions, but beware: each choice has its benefits... and risks.

[media]

[media]

Thornwake Manor is creepy on its own, but it's even creepier with its own supernatural threat. They've been guarding their treasures for some time now and get a bit upset when they're disturbed. From the moment you first grab an item, they awaken. Some stalk you when you’re alone. Some can't see you but can hear even the softest breath. Others turn the house itself against you. Learn how they behave, or become part of the house.

[media]

[media]

Explore deeper to collect valuable treasures, solve strange puzzles, and uncover hidden rooms. Push your luck for greater rewards, but fail, and everything you carry is lost.

[media]

[media]

Treasures move. Secrets shift. Friends die. Hauntings adapt. Each session becomes a different ghost story shaped by your choices and teamwork.

[media]
